The tallest is Jerry Boutsiele at 208 cm. The youngest is Dordije Jovanovic (born 2003) and the most experienced Jerry Boutsiele (born 1992). Beyond Montenegro, the squad draws most on USA (4), France (2) and Panama (1). Andrija Slavkovic is back for another spell at the club.
